verdict.rationale: Cooley's global offices page lists its own offices across the US, China (Beijing, Shanghai), Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK (London) and Belgium (Brussels), and refers to 19 international offices plus strong practices in other key markets. Practice pages describe patent, trademark and privacy teams spanning the US, UK and Europe, and Cooley GO offers UK and Singapore document versions, so a founder expanding into these markets could stay with the same firm. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-border service quality, and detail on which practices each non-US office actually covers.
